items.title: Subexponential adaptive junta-distance approximation and polynomial-query relaxed tolerant testing
items.author: Vishnu Iyer; Avishay Tal; Michael Whitmeyer
items.source_version: Complete CC BY4.0 author manuscript arxiv2106.00287v1,2021-06-01; officialmainTheorems2/3/4 junta-distance algorithms bundled with complete native Sections4–5 proofs
items.difficulty_reason: The authors sample normalized influence through random restrictions, obtain implicit access to a smaller relevant junta, and split the approximation into high-Fourier-level branching and low-level estimation to reduce adaptive queries below exponential in k.
